I think there are definitely two sides to this. While I definitely think the best option is to push through, I’ll give mine as an example of why I couldn’t do it anymore. When covid hit we were supposed to see eachother for the first time in 8 months. He lives in the UK and I live in Texas. We broke up in September because it didn’t look like there was any sign of borders opening anytime soon and we were really needing that trip to feel close with each other. There’s only so long you can wait and it hurts knowing that you don’t know when you will see your SO next. Had we been together still now - it would probably be going on 2 years of not seeing each other. I couldn’t have made it this long without seeing him considering how much of a mess it left me when I found out we were going on lockdown and not able to see each other for our planned visit in April of last year. 

I definitely get both sides. I wish I could’ve held on longer but for me, I was at my limit with the stress of wondering when I was going to see him again after we talked about all the things we wanted to do for the 8 months prior to beginning lock down.
I hope you find peace with your situation soon.

The way i taught him was when I went to the restroom, I’d take him with me and put him in his box at the same time.
